events.text: Correction: the fix sha is 69fda5624 (the review paragraph cited a wrong hash).

resolution: The Add Chunk entry was missing from the Map menu because the editor's dropdowns render from the explicit MENU_TREE structure in data/commands.ts, not from the command registry — 8b9cccdf4 registered the command, dispatch, blocking rule and dialog but never placed cmd('add-chunk') into MENU_TREE.Map, so the menu showed only the three pre-existing rows. Fixed with the one-line tree insertion (Add Chunk... now leads the Map menu). This part hot-reloads instantly — no rebuild needed; the dialog's chunk grid itself still wants the __map_chunk_list door from the 8b9cccdf4 rebuild.
